message.content: {"caption":"Average input tokens, output tokens, and cost increase across three task difficulty levels.","description":"A three-series line chart with task difficulty on the horizontal axis (level 1, level 2, level 3). The left vertical axis, “Avg Input / Output,” runs from 0 to 120,000 in 20,000 increments; the right vertical axis, “Avg Cost,” runs from 0.06 to 0.18 in 0.02 increments. The legend identifies blue circles as Avg Input, green squares as Avg Output, and pink triangles as Avg Cost. Estimated plotted values are: Avg Input rises from about 26,000 at level 1 to 48,000 at level 2 and 121,000 at level 3; Avg Output rises modestly from about 4,700 to 6,900 to 9,800; Avg Cost rises from about 0.052 to 0.087 to 0.178. Input and cost increase especially sharply between levels 2 and 3, while output increases only slightly.
